Car Race: results music
=======================

When a race ends, the game says "Game over…" and then plays music.

* If a file called  results.mp3  is in this folder, the game plays it (looped).
* If not, it plays its own built-in synth tune (generated by the browser, no file needed).

Only put music here that you are allowed to use (your own music, or a track whose
licence allows it, e.g. a royalty-free or Creative Commons track; follow any credit
it asks for). Note: the music on the original example page (234-car-race.ogg / .mp3)
is tagged as "Axel F" by Harold Faltermeyer, a commercial recording, and the original
project says its music is licensed only for that project, so it is not included here.
